components.provenance: Central convergence binding of the final V2X-01 adaptive materialization runtime to the actual Living renderer path. It consumes read-only stage, selection, scale and history inputs, gates render preparation through bounded requestAdaptive materialization and exposes measured-runtime packets without acquiring selection, camera, history, persistence, scene or scientific authority.

Central convergence-owned strict pixel binding. The Living renderer remains the single primary scene authority; V2X-13 consumes the read-only V2X-02 camera packet and externally composed scene/semantic-scale state, fails closed when the required strict WebGL2 consumer is unavailable, and owns no canonical truth or independent navigation authority.
